title: Hydrating Face Serum with Hyaluronic Acid, 30 ml
description:
A lightweight, fast-absorbing serum that leaves skin feeling soft, smooth and hydrated. Use it morning and evening before your moisturiser.
• Key ingredients: hyaluronic acid, glycerin and panthenol
• 30 ml amber glass bottle with dropper
• Fragrance-free, suitable for all skin types
• Full ingredient list (INCI) printed on the box

title: Daily Moisturising Face Cream with Shea Butter, 50 ml
description:
A rich yet non-greasy cream for day and night that helps keep skin soft and comfortable. It absorbs quickly, so it sits nicely under make-up.
• Key ingredients: shea butter, squalane and vitamin E
• 50 ml glass jar with screw lid
• Lightly scented, suitable for normal to dry skin
• Full ingredient list (INCI) printed on the box

title: Hydrating Sheet Face Masks, Pack of 10
description:
Soft sheet masks soaked in a refreshing essence for an easy at-home pamper session. Leave on for 15–20 minutes, then pat the remaining essence into your skin.
• 10 individually sealed masks with 25 ml essence each
• Choose aloe vera, green tea or cucumber essence
• Breathable cotton-blend sheet that fits most face shapes
• Single use; full ingredient list on every sachet

title: 18-Shade Eyeshadow Palette, Matte and Shimmer Neutrals
description:
A versatile palette of neutral shades, from soft everyday mattes to light-catching shimmers. Richly pigmented, blendable colours for both day and evening looks.
• 18 shades: 10 matte and 8 shimmer
• Pressed powder, 1.2 g per pan (21.6 g in total)
• Full-size mirror inside the lid
• Full ingredient list on the packaging

title: Matte Liquid Lipstick Set, 4 Long-Wear Shades
description:
Four creamy liquid lipsticks that glide on smoothly and set to a soft matte finish. Pick the classic set of nudes and red or the berry set of pinks and plums.
• 4 × 3.5 ml tubes with doe-foot applicators
• Lightweight formula that resists transfer once set
• Classic set: nude beige, rosewood, terracotta, red; berry set: pink, mauve, plum, berry
• Full ingredient list on the box

title: Creamy Satin Lipstick with Vitamin E
description:
A comfortable bullet lipstick with a soft satin finish and rich colour in a single swipe. Vitamin E and jojoba oil help lips feel smooth.
• 3.8 g bullet in a slim twist-up case
• Satin finish with buildable coverage
• Key ingredients: vitamin E and jojoba oil
• Full ingredient list on the packaging

title: Floral Eau de Parfum for Women, 50 ml
description:
A bright floral fragrance that opens with pear and bergamot, blooms into jasmine and peony, and settles on a warm musk base. Elegant enough for evenings, light enough for every day.
• Top notes: pear, bergamot; heart: jasmine, peony; base: white musk, cedar
• 50 ml glass spray bottle
• Eau de parfum concentration
• Flammable: keep away from heat and open flames

title: Woody Eau de Toilette for Men, 100 ml
description:
A fresh woody scent that blends citrus and spice with a smooth vetiver and amber base. A versatile everyday fragrance for work and weekends.
• Top notes: grapefruit, pink pepper; heart: lavender, geranium; base: vetiver, amber, cedarwood
• 100 ml glass spray bottle
• Eau de toilette concentration
• Flammable: keep away from heat and open flames

title: Quick-Dry Nail Polish Set, 6 Colours
description:
Six glossy nail polishes in a ready-to-wear mix of shades, with a fast-drying formula and a wide brush for even coverage. Two coats give full, rich colour.
• 6 bottles × 10 ml
• Touch-dry in about 60 seconds per coat
• Wide flat brush for smooth application
• Removes with any standard nail polish remover

title: Press-On Nails, 24 Pieces in 12 Sizes with Adhesive Tabs
description:
Salon-look nails in minutes, with no lamp needed. Each set includes 12 sizes so you can find a close fit for every finger.
• 24 ABS nails in 12 sizes
• Includes 24 adhesive tabs, a mini nail file and a cuticle stick
• Wear for up to 7 days with tabs; reusable when removed gently
• Styles: soft pink almond, tortoiseshell square or glitter mauve coffin

title: Ionic Hair Dryer 2000 W with Diffuser and Concentrator, EU Plug
description:
A powerful 2000 W hair dryer with an ionic function for smoother, less frizzy results. Three heat settings, two speeds and a cool-shot button let you tailor every style.
• 2000 W, 220–240 V, EU plug, 1.8 m cord
• 3 heat and 2 speed settings plus cool shot
• Includes a slim concentrator nozzle and a diffuser
• Removable rear filter and hanging loop

title: Detangling Paddle Hair Brush with Flexible Pins
description:
A wide paddle brush with flexible ball-tipped pins that glide through knots in wet or dry hair. The cushioned base follows the shape of your head as you brush.
• Size: 25 × 8.5 cm
• Nylon pins with rounded tips on an air-cushion pad
• Suitable for long, thick and curly hair
• Non-slip handle

title: Sea Salt Bath Soak with Essential Oils, 500 g
description:
Coarse sea salt blended with essential oils and dried botanicals for a relaxing, fragrant soak at the end of the day. Dissolves quickly in warm water.
• 500 g glass jar with wooden scoop
• Ingredients: sea salt, magnesium sulfate, essential oil, dried botanicals
• Use 2–3 scoops per bath
• Full ingredient list on the label

title: Handmade Olive Oil Soap Bars, Set of 6 Scents
description:
Six cold-process soap bars made with olive and coconut oils for a creamy, rich lather. A colourful assortment that makes a lovely gift or guest-bathroom set.
• 6 bars × 100 g
• Scents: lavender, citrus, rose, oat and honey, mint and sea breeze
• Palm-oil-free recipe
• Each bar wrapped in recyclable paper

title: Makeup Brush Set, 14 Pieces with Travel Pouch
description:
A complete set of soft synthetic brushes for foundation, powder, blush, contour, eyeshadow and brows. The roll-up pouch keeps every brush clean and organised.
• 14 brushes: 6 face and 8 eye brushes
• Dense synthetic fibres (no animal hair) with aluminium ferrules
• Wooden handles, 13–18 cm long
• Includes a PU leather travel pouch

title: Lighted Vanity Makeup Mirror with 12 Dimmable LED Bulbs
description:
A table-top makeup mirror framed with 12 dimmable LED bulbs for clear, even light while you apply make-up. Touch controls switch between three colour temperatures.
• Mirror size: 50 × 42 cm
• 12 LED bulbs, 3 colour modes (warm, natural, cool) with stepless dimming
• Powered by the included EU plug adapter or by USB
• Freestanding or wall-mountable

title: Bamboo Toothbrushes with Soft Bristles, Pack of 10
description:
Everyday toothbrushes with bamboo handles and soft nylon bristles. Each handle is numbered so the whole family can tell them apart.
• 10 brushes, 19 cm long
• Soft BPA-free nylon bristles
• Bamboo handles with a water-resistant finish
• Packed in recyclable kraft paper

title: Beard Care Kit with Oil, Balm, Brush and Comb
description:
Everything needed to keep a beard soft, tidy and well shaped, packed in a gift box. The oil and balm share a light cedar and bergamot scent.
• Beard oil 30 ml and beard balm 60 g
• Boar-bristle brush and wooden comb
• Key ingredients: argan, jojoba and sweet almond oils, shea butter (contains nut oil)
• Gift box: 20 × 15 × 6 cm

title: Cordless Hair Clipper with 8 Guide Combs, USB-C Rechargeable
description:
A cordless clipper for home haircuts, fades and beard trims. The stainless steel blade adjusts with a side lever, and eight guide combs cover lengths from 1.5 to 25 mm.
• Up to 120 minutes of use after a 2-hour charge, with LED battery display
• 8 guide combs: 1.5, 3, 6, 10, 13, 16, 19 and 25 mm
• USB-C charging cable included (no plug)
• Includes cleaning brush, blade oil and storage pouch

title: Wooden Massage Tool Set, 5 Pieces
description:
A set of smooth beech-wood massage tools for a relaxing self-massage of the back, shoulders, legs and feet. Simple, quiet and needs no batteries.
• Includes a multi-wheel roller, foot roller, hand paddle, round body roller and scraper board
• Natural beech wood with a sanded, oiled finish
• Roller lengths 18–30 cm
• Stored in a cotton drawstring bag

title: Massage Gun with 6 Heads and 5 Speeds, Quiet Deep Tissue Massager
description:
A handheld percussion massager to help tired muscles relax after training, a long day at a desk or a long drive.
• 5 speeds from 1,800 to 3,200 percussions per minute
• 6 interchangeable heads for large muscles, shoulders, feet and the back
• Quiet brushless motor; up to 6 hours of use per charge; USB-C
• Lightweight 650 g body with a non-slip grip; storage case included

title: Hydrocolloid Pimple Patches, 72 Invisible Dots in 3 Sizes
description:
Thin, clear hydrocolloid patches that cover blemishes overnight or under make-up, so you are not tempted to touch them.
• 72 patches in 3 sizes (8, 10 and 12 mm) for single spots or small clusters
• Hydrocolloid absorbs fluid and keeps the spot protected from dirt
• Nearly invisible on the skin; fragrance-free and vegan
• Peel, press and leave on for at least 6 hours

title: Vitamin C Serum 30 ml with Hyaluronic Acid and Vitamin E
description:
A lightweight daily serum for a brighter, more even-looking complexion, layered under moisturiser and sunscreen.
• 15% vitamin C (ascorbyl glucoside) with vitamin E and ferulic acid
• Hyaluronic acid for a plumper, hydrated feel
• Absorbs quickly without a sticky finish; fragrance-free and vegan
• Amber glass dropper bottle; made in the EU under Regulation (EC) 1223/2009

title: Silicone Scalp Massager Shampoo Brush for Wet and Dry Hair
description:
A soft silicone brush that works shampoo into the scalp and lifts away product build-up, with a pleasant massaging feel.
• Flexible silicone bristles that are gentle on the scalp and do not pull hair
• Use in the shower with shampoo or on dry hair for a quick scalp massage
• Ergonomic handle that fits the palm and does not slip when wet
• Easy to rinse and quick to dry; suitable for all hair types
